People often connect it with the UN Global pact (a separate "sustainability initiative" launched N 2000) or civic movements like Global Citizen which mobilize everyday people 2 hold leaders accountable 4 these goals.

The Pact (Resolution A/RES/79/1) consists of 5 main chapters & 2 key annexes:
Sustainable Development & Financing:
Accelerating progress on the 2030 Agenda, reforming the international financial architecture, debt distress & meeting climate targets (such as the 1.5°C limit).

International Peace & Security: 
Reaffirming the UN Charter, advancing nuclear disarmament, protecting civilians N conflicts & regulating emerging technologies like autonomous weapons.

Science, Technology & Digital Cooperation:
Operating through the Global Digital pact (an annex) 2 bridge digital divides, govern (AI) & ensure a human-rights-based digital space.

Youth & Future Generations:
Backed by the Declaration on Future Generations this commits governments 2 intergenerational solidarity, meaningful youth participation N decision-making & long-term thinking.

Transforming Global Governance:
Proposing updates 2 multilateral institutions—including the UN Security Council & global financial systems, 2 make them fit 4 21st-century realities

THE Global Compact unites over 25,000 corporate & institutional participants across 160+ countries 2 implement 10 universal principles N human rights, labor, environment & anti-corruption, feeding directly into private-sector action 4 the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs).

• Global Citizen Movement: 
Advocacy organizations like Global Citizen mobilize grassroots activists, artists & everyday citizens 2 pressure heads of state 2 fund climate action, eradicate extreme poverty & honor commitments made under UN frameworks like the Pact 4 the Future.

• Civil Society Engagement: 
The Pact explicitly emphasizes that intergovernmental agreements can no longer happen behind closed doors; 

it "mandates" broader inclusion of local communities, youth delegates & non-governmental voices N monitoring progress.
